   • In Settings → Wi-Fi Calling, turn it OFF and try again.  

5. Check messaging-app permissions  
   • Your messaging app needs permission to access Storage (for pictures) and SMS. In Settings → Apps → Messaging → Permissions, make sure Storage and SMS are allowed.
